diagram.manim_description: On a plain BG canvas of 1920 x 1080 px (y counted downward from the top edge) draw a straight ground line in GUIDE, 3 px thick, from x=300 to x=1840 at y=850. Stand seven identical-style stick-figure children on the ground line, left to right, centred at x = 410, 630, 850, 1070, 1290, 1510, 1730. Every child is drawn in INK with 5 px strokes and has no face: an empty circular head of radius 32 px, one straight body line from the bottom of the head down to the hip, two arms (each a straight line from a shoulder point 22 px below the bottom of the head, going down and outwards to a point 44 px to the side and 64 px lower) and two legs (each a straight line from the hip to a point 30 px to the left or right of the child's centre on the ground line). The hip sits 40 percent of the child's height above the ground line. The height of each child (ground line to the top of the head) is, left to right, 358, 493, 426, 526, 392, 560, 459 px, so the height ranks 1 to 7 are drawn as 1: 358, 2: 392, 3: 426, 4: 459, 5: 493, 6: 526, 7: 560 px (rank 1 = 64 percent of the tallest, each higher rank 6 percent more, rank 7 = 560 px). Above each head draw one speech bubble: an ellipse 130 px wide and 96 px high, filled CELL_FILL with a 3 px INK outline, centred horizontally on the child, its lower edge 40 px above the top of the head, with a small downward tail (a triangle 24 px wide at the ellipse edge whose point stops 10 px above the top of the head). The seven bubbles stay completely empty: no digit, no mark. Below the ground line, at y=910, write the height rank of each child, centred under the child, INK, 44 px high, left to right: 1, 5, 3, 6, 2, 7, 4. To the left of this row, right-aligned at x=270 on the same baseline y=910, write the single word height in INK, 36 px high. Crop tightly with an even margin of about 60 px around the figure; no other text, lines or decoration.
